name: modaliser-companion
description: Answers Modaliser's questions about what is open in this VSCode window, over a Unix-domain socket.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Reports and activates this window's editors and terminals, and can close a clean local text/custom tab after checking that its backing file is definitely missing. It reads metadata, never document contents, and never runs workspace code or honours workspace settings.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Listing and activation work without a local file system. Conditional cleanup applies only to local file text/custom tabs.
